'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**[[2021 Niger attacks]]
***Fourteen people are killed and one more is wounded as gunmen storm the village of Wiye, in [[Niger]]. Nine of the victims are killed while working at fields. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/27/niger-village-attack-leaves-at-least-14-dead (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Chikun kidnapping]]
**[[Nigeria]]n authorities confirm that the bandits who [[kidnap]]ped dozens of children from a school in [[Chikun]], [[Kaduna State]], have released 28 of them and that 81 others remain in captivity. This was the tenth mass kidnapping incident since December 2020. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/kidnappers-nigeria-release-28-schoolchildren-another-81-still-held-says-2021-07-25/ (Reuters)]
**Armed bandits kidnap a negotiator who had been sent to pay the ransom by the parents of the remaining students being held in captivity. The bandits had demanded nearly [[US$]]73,000. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigerian-bandits-abduct-negotiator-over-ransom-free-students-says-school-2021-07-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mali War]]
**The man who tried to kill [[Mali]]an [[President of Mali|President]] [[Assimi Goïta]] with a knife at a [[mosque]] in [[Bamako]] six days ago dies in custody. The cause of death is unknown. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/26/man-accused-of-trying-to-kill-mali-president-dies-in-custody (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Cabo Delgado]]
**[[Mozambique]] [[President of Mozambique|President]] [[Filipe Nyusi]] reports that the [[Mozambique Defence Armed Forces]] are advancing in [[Cabo Delgado Province]] and gaining territory previously held by [[Daesh]]-affiliated groups. The [[insurgency]] has caused thousands of deaths as well as monetary losses [[economy of Mozambique|Mozambique's economy]], primarily in the [[Gas industry|gas]] and [[Oil industry|oil industries]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mozambique-president-nyusi-says-army-gaining-ground-insurgency-hit-region-2021-07-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 wildfire season]]
**[[2021 California wildfires]]
***[[Dixie Fire]]
****The [[Dixie Fire]] grows to 190,000 acres in [[Butte County, California|Butte County]] and [[Plumas County, California|Plumas County]] after merging with the Fly Fire. Approximately 16 structures have been destroyed. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2021/07/25/dixie-largest-california-wildfire/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.kcra.com/article/dixie-fire-butte-plumas-county-july-24-1627238883/37123015?fbclid=IwAR22G4eMcHvuGYqat8kAxrY1f2gKgbuSE8cNQNCdi1B8NLVE9UtxNUNE9KQ (KCRA-TV)]
****The [[Plumas County, California|Plumas County]] [[Sheriff's Office]] orders mandatory evacuations in the area amid the spread of the Dixie Fire. [https://krcrtv.com/weather/wildfires/new-evacuations-ordered-as-dixie-fire-continues-to-spread-over-190000-acres-on-sunday (KRCR-TV)] [https://fox40.com/news/california-connection/californias-largest-fire-burns-homes-as-blazes-scorch-west/ (KTXL-TV)]
**An uncontrolled fire in the [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Catalonia|Catalan]] counties of [[Anoia]] and [[Conca de Barberà]] burns more than 1,100 hectares of land. The ashes reach [[Barcelona]], 100 kilometers away from the focus of the fire while a confinement order is issued for two municipalities. [https://www.elperiodico.com/es/sociedad/20210725/cenizas-incendio-santa-coloma-queralt-barcelona-11939537 (''El Periódico'')] [https://www.elconfidencial.com/espana/cataluna/2021-07-25/mas-de-200-militares-de-la-ume-se-suman-a-lucha-contra-incendio-de-barcelona_3201076/ (''El Confidencial'')]
**Massive fires in the region of [[Sardinia]], [[Italy]], damage buildings, force the evacuation of 1,500 people and destroy 20,000 hectares of land. Italy has asked for help from other [[Europe]]an countries to battle the fires. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/jul/26/firefighters-battle-wildfires-raging-across-south-west-sardinia (''The Guardian'')]
*Ten people are killed and 44 are injured in a bus crash near [[Slavonski Brod]], [[Croatia]]. The bus, traveling on a regular route from [[Frankfurt]], [[Germany]], to [[Pristina]], [[Kosovo]], swerved off the highway after one of the drivers briefly fell asleep. The driver was arrested after the incident, while the second driver was killed in the crash. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/bus-swerves-off-road-in-croatia-10-killed-30-injured/2021/07/25/d84fef3c-ed1c-11eb-a2ba-3be31d349258_story.html (''Washington Post'')]
*Nine people are killed and three more are injured in [[Himachal Pradesh]], [[India]], after being hit by falling boulders. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-57955964 (BBC News)]
*[[Flash flood]]ing in [[London]] leaves a number of [[London Underground|Underground]] stations submerged with widespread damage reported. [https://www.independent.co.uk/climate-change/london-weather-flooding-warning-latest-b1890197.html (''The Independent'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan]] 
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Jordan]]
*****[[Jordan]] begins to vaccinate children over the age of 12 using the [[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-07-jordan-covid-vaccinations-year-olds.html (MedicalXpress)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 17,045 new cases of [[COVID-19]] and surpasses one million total cases. [https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/nation/2021/07/25/record-17045-covid-19-cases-as-infections-pass-1mil-mark/?__cf_chl_jschl_tk__=pmd_b98ce3a3f6927b047b2fa4ede3081ac10d88661b-1627206711-0-gqNtZGzNAnijcnBszQii (''Free Malaysia Today'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports a record 15,335 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 497,302. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/thailand-reports-daily-record-of-15-335-coronavirus-cases-15289582 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Albania]]
****[[Albania]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant]], which was originally detected in [[India]], [https://euronews.al/en/albania/2021/07/25/presence-of-delta-variant-has-been-confirmed-in-albania/ (Euronews Albania)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iceland]]
****[[Iceland]] restricts the gatherings to 200 people, requiring bars and nightclubs to stop selling alcohol at 21:00 and close no later than midnight amid an increase of COVID-19 cases. [https://icelandmonitor.mbl.is/news/news/2021/07/23/breaking_gatherings_capped_at_200_and_one_metre_rul/ (Iceland Monitor)] 
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cuba]]
***[[Cuba]] reports a record 8,853 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://news.prensa-latina.cu/?p=41885/2021/07/25/cuba-with-8-853-covid-19-cases-and-80-deaths/ (Presna Latina)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
***[[South Africa]] returns to adjusted alert level 3, which means that inter-provincial travel can resume, alcohol sales bans are lifted, non-essential businesses can reopen, and gatherings of 50 people indoors and 100 people outdoors are allowed. Additionally, schools can reopen from 26 July 2021. [https://businesstech.co.za/news/government/508622/south-africa-moves-to-adjusted-level-3-lockdown-here-are-the-new-rules/amp/ (Businesstech)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Police in [[Fiji]] carry out a crackdown on opposition politicians and [[human rights in Fiji|human rights]] activists who are opposed to a newly proposed land bill and who criticized the handling of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji|COVID-19 pandemic in the country]]. Among those arrested are opposition politicians [[Biman Prasad]], [[Lynda Tabuya]] and [[Litia Qionibaravi]] as well as former [[Prime Minister of Fiji|Prime Minister]] [[Sitiveni Rabuka]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/447669/fiji-opposition-mps-taken-in-by-police (RNZ)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Cuban protests]]
**A [[South Florida]] caravan heads to [[Washington, D.C.]], to urge the [[Biden administration]] to take more action against [[Cuba]] and end the country's [[communist]] regime. [https://miami.cbslocal.com/2021/07/25/south-florida-caravan-dc-cuba-help/ (WFOR-TV)]
**Cuban dissidents in exile demonstrate in [[Madrid]], Spain, with the leaders of the Spanish opposition political parties. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/local/madrid/20210725/7623996/exilio-cubano-marcha-madrid-apoyo-protestas-isla.html (''La Vanguardia'')]
*[[2021 Tunisian political crisis]]
**[[Tunisia]]n [[President of Tunisia|President]] [[Kais Saied]], in a televised speech, announces the dismissal of [[Prime Minister of Tunisia|Prime Minister]] [[Hichem Mechichi]] and the suspension of the [[Assembly of the Representatives of the People]], and also assumes executive authority. The opposition calls the actions a [[coup d'état]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/25/tunisias-president-dismisses-prime-minister-after-protests (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/tunisian-president-relieves-prime-minister-his-post-2021-07-25/ (Reuters)]

***The [[Tokyo Organising Committee of the Olympic and Paralympic Games]] reports the first post-competition case of COVID-19 after [[Dutch people|Dutch]] rower [[Finn Florijn]] tested positive on Friday and self-isolated at a separate location.
